prompt: March was good, we ate well and I put something aside. April gave us almost nothing for three weeks and what I put aside is gone. I have learned not to tell my children what a good week means because they remember and then the next week is harder. Is there a way to preserve fish without equipment, something that keeps for more than a week without going bad?
